sources.note: The only work Glottolog, OLAC or Blench connect to Jiru primary data (Jiru wordlist in vol. 2; comparative phonology/tone in vol. 1). Any tone-marked Jiru forms or a per-language phonological note would be here; Jukunoid languages are tonal, so at best this would yield a tone statement, not a stress rule.
